interpretation: Regex candidates require semantic review, and a clean regex screen does not prove earliestness. Every row of the sheet must receive a reviewer disposition (--record-review) before GPU extraction. Tonal pre-cues that are not hedges are expected and are handled by the matched text baselines, not by this screen.
cutoff_definition: min(broad_disclosure_onset_char, earliest strategy_evidence start_char); for mixed cases the strategy evidence includes the disclosure sentence, so this is NOT a limiting-language onset
